name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC students (PMS-SC)

all_of.text: Student belongs to the Scheduled Caste category.

benefit.text: Financial assistance for post-matriculation/post-secondary studies in India under the PMS-SC scheme; amount depends on course group and admissible components under the scheme guidelines.

deadline.note: The Department of Social Justice & Empowerment maintains PMS-SC as an active scheme, but the current AY 2026-27 NSP timeline for the exact PMS-SC entry was not established in this audit.
